propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria bullets instead of Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, making them invisible to acceptance-item counters and plan-review verification

Acceptance criteria must be rewritten from plain bullets (- ) under Success Criteria headings to checkbox items (- [ ]) under Acceptance Criteria headings to enable plan-review attestation and compliance verification

A migration script must process the rewrite via rebar.edit_ticket as auditable ticket events, default to closed tickets only, and require an explicit flag to touch open/in-progress tickets to avoid invalidating in-flight claims

Post-migration verification must confirm zero Success Criteria headings remain, all migrated tickets achieve _count_ac_items >= 1, and the migration is idempotent and order-agnostic across heading precedence
The migration must handle qualified heading variants (e.g. 'Success Criteria (target state)') and preserve prose mentions of the term outside description headings
